objective: Measure whether structured intent and Goal Prompt construction improve Core Builder reliability when common safety and acceptance rules are held constant.

treatment.name: structured_intent_goal_prompt
treatment.description: Use the current Goal Prompt with explicit intent, goal, business flow, expected result and evaluation method; common safety and recheck rules remain fixed for both variants.

control.name: minimal_unstructured_intent
control.description: Pass only the free-form scenario, priority and must-have capabilities in the prompt header; keep testdata, acceptance, safety, workspace and publication rules identical.

primary_metrics: published cases and fresh post-publish audit passes / selected cases
CLI or Harness blocked cases / selected cases
final Core Builder output failures / selected cases
stopping_rules: Every selected case must reach a terminal status.
A case counts as published only when Builder acceptance and fresh post-publish audit both pass.
CLI/Harness transport failures are reported separately from Core Builder output failures.
No Mock result, self-report, or carried-forward baseline pass may enter the treatment denominator.

acceptance.required_claim: Only report a causal improvement if treatment and control use the same 20 cases, same provider conditions, terminal evidence, and separate failure taxonomy.
